description: A React component for a modal dialog that allows adding groups to a team in Mattermost. It manages group selection, search, pagination, and linking groups to a team.

classes.name: AddGroupsToTeamModal
classes.description: React component class for the modal dialog to add groups to a team.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial group data when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles search term changes with debounce.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets search term.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles modal exit, focusing back if needed.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles response after attempting to link groups.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits selected groups to be added to the team.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a group to the selected values.

methods.name: setGroupsLoadingState
methods.description: Sets loading state for group data.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders a group option in the multiselect.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders the display value for a selected group.
